system.description:
While the particulars of the people living in feuding bloodline cultures will depend on the environment, politics, and heritages involved, some elements are shared broadly across them all.

Hidden Blade

You are particularly adept at hiding weapons on your person due to the need for ready violence. When someone rolls a check to try and find weapons you have hidden on your body, you can expend a reaction to impose disadvantage on the roll. In addition, you gain proficiency with improvised weapons.

Smile of Knives

To maintain whatever brief peace is held between open bouts of bloodshed or mysterious poisonings, you’ve learned to keep the hatred burning in your eyes from reaching your lips in the presence of authorities or in situations where you’re outnumbered. You gain expertise on Deception or Perform checks to veil your hostility and may always use Deception for initiative in any combat which occurs during a social encounter.

Threat Assessment

After 1 minute of speaking directly to a person, or 10 minutes of observation, you can recognize whether their CR or Level is higher than your own as well as whether, or what, combat traditions they are proficient in.
